thoughts: I should probably start planning some decorations for Boxing Day.
The pixel stamp press is so much fun to use.
My whiskers are twitching, maybe it will snow later?
I am so proud of how the Frost-Moth lanterns turned out.
I wonder what kind of music the birds like in this weather.
Need to remember to check if the bakery needs more flour.
It's quiet today, a perfect time for creative thinking.
I feel very lucky to look after such a lovely, cozy town.
